name: Electron · Round 1
domainSummary: A cross-platform desktop application capability that combines a privileged Node.js main process with isolated Chromium renderer processes, joined through a narrow preload and IPC bridge and packaged with native window and operating-system integration.
evidenceBoundary: Do not depict an atom, Electron logo, monitor screen, browser chrome, or literal UI. The outer and inner architecture should communicate separated process responsibilities.

researchSources.title: Electron process model
researchSources.use: Official main, renderer, preload, context isolation, IPC, native API, and lifecycle concepts.

assets.name: Electron · Canonical Instrument
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building; emphasize main and renderer process separation
assets.thesis: The accepted skill identity is tested in its clearest production form. This version emphasizes main and renderer process separation.

assets.name: Electron · Core Mechanism

assets.name: Electron · Interface Bridge

assets.name: Electron · Layered System

assets.thesis: Modularity and composition become the identity. This version emphasizes main and renderer process separation.

assets.name: Electron · Verified Core
assets.controlledVariable: protect a compact central chamber behind explicit gates, checks, or controlled thresholds; emphasize narrow preload context bridge
assets.thesis: Correctness and validation dominate the architectural metaphor. This version emphasizes narrow preload context bridge.

assets.name: Electron · Scale Engine
assets.controlledVariable: extend the building through repeated service bays and resilient parallel paths; emphasize isolated renderer workspaces

assets.thesis: The primitive tests the smallest recognizable expression of the skill. This version emphasizes desktop window lifecycle.

assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a complete skill identity while remaining subordinate to projects and cities. This version emphasizes native API packaging boundary.
